title: Airway Management
description: Master airway techniques, tools, and complications.
content: Airway management includes techniques such as head-tilt-chin-lift, jaw-thrust, BVM ventilation, suctioning, and advanced airway placement like endotracheal intubation...

content: CPR should be initiated immediately upon confirming cardiac arrest. Follow current ACLS protocols, understand ECG basics...
